image_description: A vintage comic book cover featuring a dynamic action scene with two characters in combat. One character, wearing a green and white uniform, is being struck or thrown by a larger, red-skinned figure. The background includes explosive effects (yellow/orange bursts) and stylized text elements typical of comic book lettering. The image exhibits signs of age, such as slight discoloration and wear on the paper edges.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text in the yellow caption boxes on the right is illegible/gibberish. While common in low-res scans of old comics, AI generators often struggle with coherent text rendering. It appears more like simulated text texture than actual legible characters.
Slight softness and blurring at the extreme edges, likely due to the original scan quality or compression rather than AI generation error, but worth noting as a quality degradation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-genre or era of the comic book and verify it matches the 'comic book' class label against potential look-alikes (e.g., illustrated posters).
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text elements. AI images often fail to render coherent text, whereas real scanned comics have readable (if stylized) text.
To distinguish between natural aging artifacts (paper yellowing, scan noise) and AI-generated structural inconsistencies or unnatural blending.

focus_areas: Text legibility and coherence in caption boxes
Consistency of illustration style (line work, coloring)
Paper texture and aging artifacts vs. AI smoothing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is completely nonsensical gibberish rather than just blurry, it may indicate AI generation. However, consider that very low-resolution scans of vintage comics can also render text illegible. Look for 'melting' in the hands/fingers of the characters, a common AI failure point in action poses.
